capabilities: Create campaign notes with system, setting, party size, and status
Create NPC notes with role, location, secrets, and loot
Log sessions with summary, cliffhanger, XP, and NPC wikilinks
Track quests with giver, status, and rewards
Browse NPCs, sessions, and quests per campaign in a sidebar
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README describes features but gives no usage examples beyond invoking commands from the command palette.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in structure for running tabletop RPG campaigns, so game masters must invent their own note templates and tracking conventions.
summary: Campaign management plugin that structures TTRPG campaigns with NPCs, locations, factions, session logs, quests, and loot in markdown notes.
